title: Upgrade Progression & Lack of counter explanation
body: I really enjoy AmaZeus and spend a lot of time playing it. However, I’ve noticed that progressing through the game can feel pretty slow, especially when it comes to upgrading armor, weapons, and leveling up. It takes a long time to get new gear, and even when I upgrade my existing equipment, the improvements barely seem noticeable. Because of this, I often find myself stuck in the same arena longer than I’d like. Speaking of arenas, I think it would be great if different creatures had specific elemental weaknesses. For example, fire could be effective against skeletons, while electricity could work better against bats. Knowing which elements are most effective against certain enemies would allow players to make more strategic decisions instead of simply relying on stronger gear. Overall, I really enjoy the game, but I think making upgrades feel more rewarding and adding elemental weaknesses would make the gameplay even more engaging and enjoyable.

title: Good game, wonderful concept
body: I love the game for its mechanics, feel, and enjoyable gameplay. I’ve played it for about a month now, maybe more, and I’ve gotten all the way to chapter five, waiting on the release of future chapters. All of my gear is almost golden, and I’m at 50+ in terms of leveling. It’s also wonderful that it’s not pay to win, nor is it impossible to get good loot or a head start. I haven’t spent a dime, yet still managed to do a lot of things in a short period. That being said, I have some issues, mainly with the lack of content being released, but I’m not angry, just excited to see more. I’d recommend it to friends if I could. Another issue I find is with the damage balancing on some of the bosses, especially in the star challenges, I completed the final boss on star challenge before I even came close to beat Hall of the Usurper. The bosses that move and attack while you’re stuck in place as the animations gathering up the tornados or special abilities is really really annoying, and unfair. You have a challenge where you can’t take more than three hits, but if your perks are built in a way to use the abilities in the chests like lightning, fire arrow, tornado, or otherwise, you cannot move until the hits are counted up, and the abilities are done being deployed. It’s sort of like being punished for having a strong build, but that’s my opinion, I still beat the challenge, but it took multiple tries. The 6 games before energy depletion is a little low, especially considering you have at least 4 missions before the end of each chapter, and about 20 star challenges. That’s not even counting retrying or replaying. That’d take 40 tries if you beat all of it first try, so that’d take about 4 whole days to get the correct amount of energy needed to play. Maybe just shortening it to 30 minutes per refill of an energy, or extending it to 24/24 would be great! But even still, they’re doing a great job, its simple animation may make it seem like just another slop, money grab, PTW game, but once you play it, it’s actually a really cool and complex game. It’s an awesome concept too. Keep it up, and if you’re reading this, give Zeus a try, I’m pretty happy with it. I usually play it when I just have a bit of free time. It’s not too grindy, it’s a nice relaxing experience if you need a quick break!
